related.title: 勒索事件桌上演練：隔離、乾淨復原與相依順序
related.titleEn: Ransomware tabletop: isolation, clean recovery and dependencies
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12檔雜湊清單、36筆交接、兩筆缺項說明及副本變更實驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve file digests, thirty-six handoffs, two gap disclosures and the working-copy modification experiment.
related.difference: 將身分服務、資料庫、應用與備份驗證畫成相依圖，先確認乾淨復原環境與必要存取。
related.differenceEn: Map identity, database, application and backup-validation dependencies, confirming a clean recovery environment and required access.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保管鏈完整率=必要欄位齊全的交接/預期交接；雜湊只能支持位元一致，不能證明來源敘述真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成證據檔各需3次交接，共36筆；34筆有完整雙方、時間與雜湊紀錄。 完整率34/36=94.4444%；兩筆缺項仍必須列為限制。
復原完工時間由相依關係的關鍵路徑決定，不是所有工時任意相加或取最大。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 身分復原30分鐘，之後資料庫40分鐘，再啟動應用25分鐘；備份驗證20分鐘可與身分復原平行。 關鍵路徑30+40+25=95分鐘；平行的20分鐘驗證不額外延長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Custody completeness counts fully documented required handoffs; hashes support byte equality, not the truth of origin claims. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twelve synthetic evidence files require three handoffs each, thirty-six total; thirty-four include complete parties, time and digest. Completeness=34/36=94.4444%; disclose the two incomplete handoffs as limitations.

Recovery completion follows the dependency critical path, not an arbitrary sum or maximum of task times. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Identity recovery takes thirty minutes, then database forty, then application twenty-five; twenty-minute backup validation runs in parallel with identity. The critical path is 30+40+25=95 minutes; parallel twenty-minute validation adds no further delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CISA 零信任成熟度：用證據追蹤五大支柱
related.titleEn: CISA zero-trust maturity: evidence across five pillars
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12檔雜湊清單、36筆交接、兩筆缺項說明及副本變更實驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve file digests, thirty-six handoffs, two gap disclosures and the working-copy modification experiment.
related.difference: 為五大支柱各設五項可驗證需求；將政策文件、實際設定、測試結果分欄，缺少測試的控制保持未驗證。
related.differenceEn: Define five testable requirements per pillar; separate policy text, implemented configuration and test results, leaving untested controls unverified.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保管鏈完整率=必要欄位齊全的交接/預期交接；雜湊只能支持位元一致，不能證明來源敘述真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成證據檔各需3次交接，共36筆；34筆有完整雙方、時間與雜湊紀錄。 完整率34/36=94.4444%；兩筆缺項仍必須列為限制。
證據覆蓋率=有完整且未過期證據的需求數/固定需求總數；成熟度等級是序位，不能直接平均成安全分數。 教學清單25項；17項有設定快照、負責人與最近一次測試，8項缺證據。 覆蓋17/25×100=68%；補齊4項後21/25×100=84%，仍有4項未驗證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Custody completeness counts fully documented required handoffs; hashes support byte equality, not the truth of origin claims. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twelve synthetic evidence files require three handoffs each, thirty-six total; thirty-four include complete parties, time and digest. Completeness=34/36=94.4444%; disclose the two incomplete handoffs as limitations.

Evidence coverage is complete, fresh evidence divided by a fixed requirement count; maturity categories are ordinal, not numbers to average into a security score. A teaching checklist has 25 requirements; 17 have a configuration snapshot, owner and recent test, while 8 lack evidence. Coverage is 17/25×100=68%; completing 4 more yields 21/25×100=84%, with 4 unverified.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
